alt: October 2025 calendar page: a watercolour of lit clay diyas glowing against a dark night, their reflections below. Gandhi’s birthday, Diwali, Lakshmi Puja and Chhath Puja are marked.
caption: An illustrated October 2025 calendar features glowing diya lamps set against a dark watercolor splash.
description: The artwork displays a cluster of ornate clay lamps with bright, flickering flames arranged within a deep blue and black ink blot. This central illustration sits above a standard monthly grid for October 2025. Several dates are marked in red text with specific festival names such as Gandhi Jayanti, Diwali, and Chath Puja.
